channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Paul George | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Paul George from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Danilo Gallinari on Paul George
item.description:
Danilo Gallinari:

“That was the first time where I got traded not because of an owner or GM or coach situation or request. It was clearly a player request that didn't like what he saw. He wanted his friend or whatever relationship was there with Paul George, and so that was what I didn't like. I didn't say anything bad.”

Danilo Gallinari on Paul George, Sep 17, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Paul George
item.description:
“I think the biggest thing is, it’s (George), plus the picks, plus the optionality moving forward,”

Brad Stevens on Paul George, Jul 6, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Paul George, Jaylen Brown
item.description:
Brad Stevens on the Celtics’ fans reaction to trading Jaylen Brown for Paul George:

“I've done a pretty good job of staying off of all the social media the last few days.”

Brad Stevens on Paul George, Jaylen Brown, Jul 6, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: AJ Dybantsa on Paul George, Tracy McGrady, Jalen Brunson
item.description:
AJ Dybantsa on his NBA player comparisons:

“Some people say younger Paul George. I have heard a bigger Shai, I have heard a bigger Jalen Brunson. But the most accurate one I have ever got was Tracy McGrady. I think he was just super uber-talented, being 6'9, jumping over people to shoot, being a windmill, and being super athletic. I think that is kind of me.”

AJ Dybantsa on Paul George, Tracy McGrady, Jalen Brunson, Jun 26, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Paul George, Jalen Brunson
item.description:
Jaylen Brown:

“You know how many players do that? That is such the common basketball play. Every player does it. So why are you targeting me? It clearly had an agenda. Maybe because I had spoken, I was critical of the refs in the regular season. So, you know, how they responded: like, ‘We’re going to call every—we’re going to—you’re going to lead the playoffs in offensive fouls.’That was the response from the officiating crew. You could clearly tell. And I actually spoke to some refs, and they said it was an agenda going into each game. So, anytime Jaylen brings his arm up, just from reputation, just call it. Paul George does the same thing. Jalen Brunson does the same thing. I can go down the list.”

Jaylen Brown on Paul George, Jalen Brunson, May 4, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Tyrese Maxey on Paul George
item.description:
“Once [George] came back from his 25 games, he had a mission and I think he's accomplishing that mission. He's been really good. We appreciate him and we appreciate his sacrifice. But he's done a great job,”

Tyrese Maxey on Paul George, May 1, 2026. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Paul George
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Paul George’s time in OKC:

“Aesthetically pleasing offensive game. The ball just goes in the net nicer when he shoots it. He’s a great offensive player that also plays defense.”

Mark Daigneault on Paul George, Dec 27, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Paul George
item.description:
Nurse said.

“They need to teach these guys how to be pros, kind of some ins and outs of the league. I sat down with Paul George for a long time the other day and I was like listen, you are a great like defensive player and there's a lot of tricks, anticipation things, like you need to teach these guys this like quick. Teach them how to, you know, the cheat codes or whatever they are to get them up to speed quicker.”

Nick Nurse on Paul George, Oct 1, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Patrick Beverley on Andre Iguodala, Paul George, Klay Thompson, Draymond Green
item.description:
Beverley revealed he thinks Golden State would have won more than four titles if Paul George replaced Thompson.

“If you put Paul George in that role playing as Klay Thompson, playing with [Steph Curry, Draymond Green, Andre Iguodala] at a point -- obviously we know Paul George a couple years ago, was in the MVP race,”

Patrick Beverley on Andre Iguodala, Paul George, Klay Thompson, Draymond Green, Aug 25, 2025. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Ace Bailey on Kevin Durant, Paul George, Jayson Tatum
item.description:
Ace Bailey on player comparisons:

“Big 3. KD (Kevin Durant), Paul George and Jayson Tatum. George and Tatum, their creation for them to get their shot off is unbelievable. I see myself doing the same thing. KD in the mid post with one, two dribbles, or less is straight buckets.”

Ace Bailey on Kevin Durant, Paul George, Jayson Tatum, May 14, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Paul George
item.description:
Sixers president of basketball operations Daryl Morey told ESPN's Tim Bontemps earlier this month that Philadelphia would try to keep both Embiid and Paul George out of back-to-backs this season.

“We're going to be smart about it. Part of being smart about it is having both Paul [George] and Joel probably not play many back-to-backs, if any,”

Daryl Morey on Paul George, Oct 23, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard on Paul George
item.description:
Kawhi Leonard on Clippers losing Paul George:

“I don’t feel like it’s going to be harder for me personally. For anybody I’m on the court with, I don’t look at him to be my savior.”

Kawhi Leonard on Paul George, Sep 30, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Paul George
item.description:
After building a perennial contender around George and Leonard for the past five years, now the Clippers will try not to miss the postseason for just the third time in 14 seasons.

“When you lose a guy of Paul George's stature, instantly people [think] oh, they can't win or they're not going to be competitive,”

Tyronn Lue on Paul George, Aug 28, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Paul George
item.description:
“As excited as we are about some of the things — obviously Paul George headlining — I think a lot of the other moves were super critical,”

Nick Nurse on Paul George, Jul 25, 2024. Source: Sixers Wire.

item.title: Ivica Zubac on Paul George
item.description:
Ivica Zubac on Paul George leaving for the Sixers:

“That’s a great friend. We played together for 5 seasons. It’s definitely tough seeing him leave. He was a big piece. It’s gonna be hard to replicate for us, he did so much, but there’s a business side [to basketball].Unfortunately, that was the best decision for him, we’re gonna miss him a lot, but we signed some new guys. We got to work with what we have already and I’m sure we’re gonna have a great season.”

Ivica Zubac on Paul George, Jul 2, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Udonis Haslem on Paul George
item.description:
Former NBA player Udonis Haslem believes the Philadelphia 76ers would be a great fit for George.

“I gotta say the Philadelphia 76ers. They were at the bottom of the league in catch-and-shoot 3s, Paul George made about 145 catch-and-shoot 3s last year,”

Udonis Haslem on Paul George, Jun 24, 2024. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Joel Embiid on Paul George
item.description:
Joel Embiid on the Celtics and recruiting free agents to the Sixers:

“I can’t stand them. I hate Boston. Great city. Great fans. They’ve got some great players. Hopefully, this offseason, we find a way to get better and add some pieces (looks at Paul George next to him).”

Joel Embiid on Paul George, Jun 14, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Jay Williams on Paul George
item.description:
“If I were Paul George, I would be looking at that [Sixers] situation... I love Kawhi, but if you're not available, what position does that put me in if I want to win championships?”

Jay Williams on Paul George, May 30, 2024. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Ryan Dunn on Paul George, OG Anunoby, Herb Jones
item.description:
Ryan Dunn:

“There are a lot of players I watch like Paul George and Herb Jones too defensively. I think the closest I probably have is OG Anunoby right now with him in the playoffs with his size and strength defensively.”

Ryan Dunn on Paul George, OG Anunoby, Herb Jones, May 21, 2024. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Paolo Banchero on Paul George
item.description:
“A lot of these guys I’m playing against — KD, Bron, Steph, Paul George, [James] Harden — I’ve been watching since I was 8 or 9 years old,”

Paolo Banchero on Paul George, May 17, 2024. Source: Washington Post.

item.title: Terance Mann on Paul George
item.description:
“I think it is more mental than anything with me because he’s going to make the tough shots. He’s going to take the tough shots and you see them go in, you think you playing good defense, you see them go in. It’s just tough. “The pump fake he going to get you a couple times in the series. He got P [Paul George] a couple times. I don’t know why he got P, after I told him to stay down on the move but he still jump. But yea, I think mentally it’s just taxing, but a lot of film is helping me out and the coaches for sure.”

Terance Mann on Paul George, May 1, 2024. Source: TalkBasket.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Paul George
item.description:
Here's Tyronn Lue on Paul George:

“We didn't want to get him worn down throughout the course of the season and having to make every play… we talked about the last 20 games, putting the ball back in PG's hands… when we get to the playoffs, we know exactly what we want to do.”

Tyronn Lue on Paul George, Mar 15, 2024. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Dillon Brooks on Paul George
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Dillon Brooks on defending Wemby:

“I wish we played them again. It means I’m doing something right. Different (scouting reports) bring different things to different players. I’m glad to be a versatile player, guarding Wemby or guarding Paul George the next day.”

Dillon Brooks on Paul George, Mar 13, 2024. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Paul George, Tracy McGrady
item.description:
Kevin Durant on GOAT conversations:

“I almost say that stuff to challenge people's thinking on why do you even have a GOAT list for one and what does it actually mean in the grand scheme of things? And to also highlight that it is such a subjective thing that I can ask 20 people that you may not ever know or talk to who's their GOAT.And they may say me, they may say Tracy McGrady or Paul George, but what does it matter at the end of the day?”

Kevin Durant on Paul George, Tracy McGrady, Feb 20, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard on Paul George, James Harden
item.description:
Kawhi Leonard on his extension impacting Paul George and James Harden’s futures:

“I think for the most part, everybody is coming back, so with me signing the extension, it gives us a chance to sign both players.”

Kawhi Leonard on Paul George, James Harden, Jan 11, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Paul George, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
Doc Rivers on the Shai Gilgeous-Alexander/Paul George trade:

“I even told Kawhi when he was saying ‘I need another guy’… I kept saying, ‘Kawhi, Shai’s gonna be a star.’”

Doc Rivers on Paul George, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Dec 13, 2023. Source: Twitter @BillSimmons.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Paul George, Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Law Murray:Lue on George and Leonard continued:

“Whatever I want to do, they're going to do it. They trust me, I think I've earned their trust over the last 3 years. So whatever's best for the team, that's the move we're going to make.”

Tyronn Lue on Paul George, Kawhi Leonard, Oct 3, 2023. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on Paul George, Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
L Frank on continued extension talks with Leonard/George:

“It's still the same. We're still trying to maximize Kawhi and PG's window and take advantage of it... we've had consistent ongoing conversations with both them and their representatives.”

Lawrence Frank on Paul George, Kawhi Leonard, Sep 27, 2023. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Patrick Beverley on Paul George, Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
“Why every time they show the team they show the Clippers? Every app I've seen it on they showed Kawhi Leonard and Paul George. That's f*cked up.”

Patrick Beverley on Paul George, Kawhi Leonard, Sep 20, 2023. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on Paul George, Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
L Frank on Paul George/Kawhi Leonard extension talk:

“We want to keep them as Clippers for a long time. And so we'll look forward to those conversations... those guys have been great partners. So at the appropriate time, we look forward to sitting down.”

Lawrence Frank on Paul George, Kawhi Leonard, Apr 27, 2023. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.
